title: Rectitude Holdings Ltd. Introduces AIMS Performance Guarantee Program for Energy Efficiency Grant-Eligible Contractors
summary: Rectitude launches a performance guarantee pilot program for contractors deploying SuperSun All-in-One Intelligence Microgrid System (AIMS) SS-250D and SS-500D systems under Singapore’s Energy Efficiency Grant (EEG). The program establishes baseline fuel displacement targets, supported by partial lease credits if modeled thresholds are not met during initial operations.
